m3_rule: Re-derived, one rule for every round. strict = the finding's own text says the defect was introduced by a named previous fix. partial = the report links the finding to a previous finding ('Residue of ...', or listed in Part 1 as the residue/follow-on of a row). pre_existing_stated = the report says the defect predates the revision. not_stated = no origin or link in the report (these are NOT guessed). linked = strict + partial. Where the Decisions row says 'predates', that wins over a Part 1 link (R3-4, R3-9).

origin_master_reuse_in_findings.rule: Counted in the findings tables only. 'master-only path' = src/superclaude/core/WORKER-CONTRACT.md, src/superclaude/commands/{graph,impact,issue}.md, or the string origin/.
